evals.prompt: Build the DD model for Asset Guardian from the seller data folder. The dataroom files (IM, abridged accounts FY23-25, management accounts 25/26, updated P&L, revenue by customer, staff breakdown & costs, customer tenure, accrual figures, plus qualitative docs) are in the input folder. Target has a March year end. Produce the master Excel workbook.
evals.expected_output: Asset Guardian Master.xlsx following Tern conventions (Nunito 11 house formatting): L (tab map only, no change log/dataroom index), PL starting on row 1 with FY..A/F columns, year end in C3, Grouping column, Tern Y1 mirroring the current-year forecast with payroll built from CB via SUMIFS on the K or N flag, no Difference/CAGR columns; CB listing ending at fully loaded cost plus K or N and both C&B reconciliations; R with gross churn as its own section; provenance-labelled sections; QA data requests with priority (including contractor double-count and forecast support as Critical); disagreeing source files ingested side by side with a (Tern) reconciliation; cached values written back so the file renders in Drive
